name: Mandarin Oriental, Costa Navarino
positioning: Beachfront resort of earth-sheltered suites and villas overlooking the Bay of Navarino on the southwest coast of the Peloponnese
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront resort with private-pool villas

facts.text: The resort is on the southwest coast of the Peloponnese, overlooking the Bay of Navarino.
The resort's architecture draws inspiration from the region's traditional stone structures, known as "mandria".
The suites and villas are earth-sheltered.
Each accommodation features a private terrace and sea views.
All villas offer private swimming pools.
Oliviera celebrates the richness of contemporary Greek cuisine.
Tahir brings together the vibrant flavours of Italy and the Levant.
Brasserie de la Bay offers all-day dining inspired by a modern French brasserie.
Three Admirals Lounge is the resort's signature cocktail destination.
Pizza Sapienza by Daniele Cason presents an omakase-style pizza experience.
The resort has been awarded the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star rating.

highlights.text: The Spa has been awarded the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star rating.
The spa's heat and water facilities include an olive sauna.
The spa offers treatments called the Essence of Costa Navarino, based on the local environment and ingredients from local sources.
Costa Navarino offers access to four signature golf courses.
Ormos Beach Club offers a sun lounger or private cabana on Navarino Bay.

considerations.text: Athens International Airport is approximately a 3-hour drive away.
Reservations are strongly recommended for all of the restaurants, particularly during the summer season.
Children are not welcome at Pizza Sapienza and The Private Kitchen.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires planned transportation for exploring beyond the resort.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
